document: Galaxy-HRGuard v1.7 SEALED independent confirmation -- RESULT
authorisation_scope: A1 unseal + A2 local extraction + A3 one zero-fit run

clock_rule.rule: closed candidate set {raw:0, author_minus_9h:-32400000}; score = fraction of Polar timestamps inside the watch-PPG timestamp range; PASS iff best >= 0.75 AND best-second >= 0.30 AND the residual envelope holds. Timestamps only; reference HR error is never used.

primary_estimand_E1.definition: pooled supply share = wrong-value windows / (wrong-value windows + refused windows); refused = a valid Polar reference exists and no usable watch value was delivered
primary_estimand_E1.criterion: the entire 95% participant-level bootstrap interval of the pooled supply share lies below 0.50
primary_estimand_E1.interpretation: 0.1212 means that of every 100 unreliable windows, about 12.1 carried a wrong value and about 87.9 were the device refusing to output at all

E2_within_person_activity_gradient.why_descriptive: no admissible one-sided exact test at n <= 5 satisfies the pre-registered credibility rule; at n = 4 the smallest attainable one-sided p is 0.0625 > alpha = 0.05 and at n = 5 the exact test requires all five participant deltas to be positive (power about 0.52). A null result is UNTESTED, never refuted.

E5_eta2_participant_share.note: no eta-squared quantity is reported in the confirmation side

independent_recomputation.implementation: separate module, no import from v1_6_confirm_run / audit_raw_dev / probe_dev_windows

bootstrap.method: independent RNG stream and n_boot=20000, so exact equality is not expected; agreement is judged on whether the two intervals overlap and both stay below the 0.50 benchmark

independent_recomputation.reading: the two implementations agree exactly on the point estimate, on the per-participant numerator and denominator and on the exact p value; the bootstrap intervals differ only in the upper bound because the RNG stream and n_boot differ, and both lie entirely below 0.50

paper_decision.label: CONFIRMED_NARROW_CLAIM
paper_decision.reason: the supply-boundary component is independently supported; the activity component is reported as a descriptive within-person observation because the held-out cohort was not powered to test it
paper_decision.decided_by: the frozen decision matrix in V1_7_SEALED_RUNBOOK.md section 5, applied to the estimate and its interval only

deviations_and_incidents.what: the v1.7 runbook section 2 said ACC need not be extracted, but the inherited inclusion rule G-EVAL clause (1) requires all five raw files present and label_participant() reads the full FILES map; the first preflight therefore returned DATA_NOT_EVALUABLE for all six on a bookkeeping technicality
deviations_and_incidents.fix: ACC was extracted for all six (48.76 MB) so that the STRICTER rule is satisfied
deviations_and_incidents.effect_on_results: none -- a static check confirms watch_acc is read but never referenced by any estimand (0 occurrences in the estimator code)

deviations_and_incidents.what: stage_preflight called infer_offset(watch_ppg, polar) while the frozen semantics (audit_raw_dev.infer_offset) are infer_offset(polar, watch_ppg). The candidate offset is added to the REFERENCE timestamps, so the reversed order makes both candidate scores exactly 0.0 (NO_MATCH) for every participant
deviations_and_incidents.detection: all six participants returned identical 0.0/0.0 overlap, which is impossible for genuinely misaligned clocks because the raw timestamp ranges differ by about nine hours
deviations_and_incidents.fix: argument order corrected; verified WITHOUT looking at any SEALED label: on DEV the corrected call reproduces the frozen decision for 16/16 subjects (test_clock_rule.py), and the DEV three-layer verification was re-run to DEV_VERIFY_OK with max_abs_diff 0.0
deviations_and_incidents.effect_on_results: the run that produced the reported estimate uses the corrected call; no SEALED label was computed or inspected before the fix

verification_status.dev_three_layer: DEV_VERIFY_OK (layer1 8/8, layer2 24924x5 zero diff, layer3 6/6) after the D2 fix
verification_status.criterion_audit: REPLACED by an exact sign-flip test, then DEMOTED TO DESCRIPTIVE because no admissible one-sided test at n <= 5 satisfies the pre-registered credibility rule

mandatory_disclosures.text: The sibling project <sibling-project> parsed the raw signals of P17 / P19 / P20 / P23 (and had byte-level access to P08 / P13) on 2026-11-02, BEFORE this project's protocol was frozen. Subject-level statistics and a 32,397-row window cache were written, with no activity labels (session = '?'). None of the seven estimands can be computed from those artefacts, and no sibling value entered any DEV-side decision. It is nevertheless NOT correct to describe this cohort as never handled by anyone.

P08 lacks GalaxyWatch/HR.csv. A missing file makes 'the device emitted nothing' indistinguishable from 'the file was not recorded', so P08 enters neither a numerator nor a denominator and is NOT counted as a device refusal. Evaluable n = 5.

mandatory_disclosures.topic: no power for the activity component
mandatory_disclosures.text: At n <= 5 no admissible one-sided exact test can carry the activity component: at n = 4 the smallest attainable p is 0.0625 > 0.05, and at n = 5 rejection requires all five deltas to be positive (power about 0.52). This is a property of the design, not of the data. A null result is UNTESTED, never refuted.

not_done: no rerun after seeing the result
